about: Consiglio (Torino 1787, «Del giuoco del Consiglio», p. 97): four players as in Partita, with the one difference that the two partners sit side by side, show each other their cards and talk freely; «tutto è simile al giuoco di Partita in quattro». To win some players need 46 points, others the most points over a round in which the cards are dealt four times; the table agrees which before the deal (p. 97). The base file plays the first custom; the second is the variant «sum_of_four_deals». Everything not written here is as in Partita, two against two.

prammatica1846.cite: L. B., Prammatica del giuocatore di tarocchi ossia regole indispensabili per gli amatori di simile passatempo, Torino, Serra, [1846] (separate issue, cover dated 1846, deposited 27 December 1845; reprinted from the same setting, same pages, as part II of Il giuocatore di tarocchi al tavoliere, Torino, Serra, [1846])

count.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: «giuocasi in quattro persone, come in Partita».

seating.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: «le due persone, che sono insieme, seggono vicine».

mode.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: as in Partita, two against two.

options.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 90: «del convenuto»: the payment is agreed before the deal; the book names no figure; the choices are ours (as in Partita, p. 97: «tutto è simile al giuoco di Partita in quattro»).

deck.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: «Del rimanente tutto è simile al giuoco di Partita in quattro»: the same deal, 4 × 19 + 2 = 78.

fool_exchange_to.source: [R] Torino [1846], part I, p. 33 (Venticinque for three): «onde chi ha presa o coperta la mano non abbia ad averne danno»: the plain card for the Fool goes to whoever took the trick; Torino 1787, pp. 77-78 says the same of Permesso for five to seven: «la carta poscia del Folle si dovrà sempre dare a chi ha preso». Written here, not only inherited from Partita for four: the pages of Consiglio (1787, p. 97) do not name it. Other reading (stood until revision 8): the card goes to the opposing side.

group.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: «presso cert'uni poter contare quarantasei punti»: 46 of 91, the count in pairs of p. 52. Counting by four (Partita, p. 89) is not offered here: 46 of 72 is out of reach (revision 9, answer 6 of the lead session).

winner.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 97: «Per vincere basta presso … contare quarantasei punti; … in tutto il giro»: the first custom is the base, the second a variant; the table must agree beforehand («fa ancor mestiere d'intendersela prima di giuocare»).

target.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: «presso cert'uni poter contare quarantasei punti»: 46, counted in pairs.

variants.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: «presso altri è chi fa più punti … le carte tutte quattro le volte»: the part with more points over four deals wins.

winner.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: the part that makes more points over the round wins; each hand only adds its points.

kind.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 97: a round of four deals; in this format `fixed_hands` counts game points per hand, the book counts the points of all four deals together; the partita is paid once at the end (match.payout).

hands.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: «tutte quattro le volte»: four deals. [R] That each player deals once is our reading; Torino [1846], part I, p. 36 says so of Partita for four.

tiebreak.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 97: the part with more points «in tutto il giro» wins; game points are none, so this key decides the variant by the card points of the four hands together; equal totals are a draw (equal totals «rende pace», Prammatica [1846], p. 29).

payout.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: the part with more points «in tutto il giro» wins; Prammatica [1846], pp. 29-30: one stake at the end, the «coda»; equal totals «rende pace», nobody pays. [S] The size is ours: it is reckoned as the payment of one deal (settle: pair_split, as at Partita), one stake from each seat of the losing pair; no payment after each deal in this variant.

dealer_rounds.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 97: the second custom counts the points «in tutto il giro», the cards dealt «tutte quattro le volte»: a round of four deals. The base file plays the first custom (46 points in one deal) and keeps the same round as the length of a match, our reading; the marche are settled after every deal, as at Partita («tutto è simile al giuoco di Partita in quattro»). The second custom with one stake at the end waits for the format; Prammatica [1846], pp. 29-30 has such a stake, the «coda». The table may agree on two or three rounds.

replace.what: one stake at the end of the partita, or the marche after every deal

play.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 97: partners «si consultano liberamente»; a bot partner shares its hand and plays a legal card the human partner suggests ([S] our rule for the bot).
